lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Commander?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Are you busy now?
No.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I, um... actually have a tiny issue... I'm not sure if you could call it a problem, but...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I was hoping I could discuss it with you.
What is it?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I see all kinds of cases

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: working in a hospital,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: so nothing really shocks me anymore.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: But Mihara came to the hospital not too long ago

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: and told us she wasn't feeling well.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: So I gave her an injection in the arm,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: and she...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: seemed...to enjoy it?
Oh?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Not only that, she asked if I could give her another injection on her butt.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I was so taken aback that I couldn't even answer her.
That's just Mihara doing what Mihara does.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Doing what she does?
So she's just a patient like everybody else?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: You're right!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: There are all kinds of people in the world,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: so there's no way I can understand every one of them right off the bat.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I can't let this experience get me down!
That's the spirit. Next time you meet Mihara, just treat her nicer.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I will!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I'll try and be more understanding next time.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Thanks, Commander!
Happy to help.
